entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought. This is ridiculous.

I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't give me a script! It's a fault! They're junk! I've been on three rides and they've given me horrible blisters. On top of that, the cleats won't stay tight. I want a full refund, and I don't want to wait.

I understand your frustration, getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. That sounds very unpleasant. Let me just pull up your account and take a look at the return policy for you. Can I get your name or order number?

The name is Michael Sterling. And you'd better find it. I'm a VIP member, and if this isn't handled, I'm posting a review about this on every cycling blog on the internet. This is completely unacceptable.

Okay Mr. Sterling, I see your account now. Thank you for your loyalty with us. I'm just reviewing your order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes... I see it was delivered 59 days ago. One moment while I confirm the policy.
Don't try to tell me it's too late. I swear, if you try and pull some fine print on me, I'll demand a manager.

Not at all, sir. I've just checked, and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return and get you a full refund. My apologies for the trouble the shoes have caused you with the blisters and the loose cleats.
Oh. Well... fine. Good. So you're sending me a label? How does this work?

Yes, I've just processed the return authorization. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Once the carrier scans the package, we will issue the refund to your original payment method. And for the inconvenience this has caused, and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a $50 store credit to your account.
A $50 credit? Okay. That's... acceptable. That's good service. Just make sure that email shows up.
It should be in your inbox already. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mr. Sterling?
No, that's it for now. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
